Front: Kth largest with min heap of size k: {{c1::if len(heap) < k: heappush(heap, num); elif num > heap[0]: heapreplace(heap, num)}}
Kth largest - answer is: {{c1::heap[0]}}
Top K frequent - push: {{c1::for num, freq in counter.items(): heappush(heap, (freq, num)); if len(heap) > k: heappop(heap)}}
Last stone weight: {{c1::while len(heap) > 1: y = -heappop(heap); x = -heappop(heap); if y != x: heappush(heap, -(y-x))}}
K closest points - distance: {{c1::dist = x*x + y*y}} (no need for sqrt)
K closest with max heap: {{c1::heappush(heap, (-dist, point)); if len(heap) > k: heappop(heap)}}
Merge k lists - init: {{c1::heap = [(head.val, i, head) for i, head in enumerate(lists) if head]}}
Merge k lists - process: {{c1::val, i, node = heappop(heap); curr.next = node; if node.next: heappush(heap, (node.next.val, i, node.next))}}
Find median - two heaps: {{c1::small = []}} (max heap), {{c2::large = []}} (min heap)
Find median - add number: {{c1::heappush(small, -num); heappush(large, -heappop(small)); if len(large) > len(small): heappush(small, -heappop(large))}}
Find median - get median: {{c1::if len(small) > len(large): return -small[0]; return (-small[0] + large[0]) / 2}}
Task scheduler - count remaining: {{c1::heappush(heap, -count) for count in counter.values()}}
Task scheduler - cooldown queue: {{c1::queue.append((-count + 1, time + n))}}
Reorganize string - pick most frequent: {{c1::count, char = heappop(heap); result.append(char); if prev_count < 0: heappush(heap, (prev_count, prev_char)); prev_count, prev_char = count + 1, char}}
Kth Largest Element: Find kth largest. Approach?

Front: Top K Frequent Elements: Find k most frequent. Approach?
Back: Min heap of size k with (freq, elem) pairs

Front: Last Stone Weight: Smash stones, return last. Approach?
Back: Max heap, smash two heaviest until one or none left

Front: K Closest Points: Find k closest to origin. Approach?
Back: Max heap of size k with negative distances

Front: Merge K Sorted Lists: Merge k lists. Approach?
Back: Min heap of k heads, pop min and push its next

Front: Find Median from Data Stream: Continuous median. Approach?
Back: Two heaps: max heap for lower half, min heap for upper

Front: Task Scheduler: Min intervals to complete tasks. Approach?
Back: Max heap + queue for cooldown tracking

Front: Reorganize String: No adjacent same chars. Approach?
Back: Max heap, always pick most frequent not same as last

Front: Why use min heap of size k for kth largest?
Back: Heap root is the kth largest; smaller elements are rejected

Front: Why use max heap for lower half in median finding?
Back: Quick access to max of lower half (closest to median)

Front: Why include index in merge k lists heap?
Back: Tie-breaker when values are equal (Python requires comparable elements)

Front: Why not use sqrt for K closest points?
Back: Comparing d² gives same order as d, avoiding sqrt is faster
